title: Prospective registry study: Metastatic soft tissue sarcoma
summary: In dieser Studie werden Patienten mit Weichgewebssarkom und neu aufgetretener Fernmetastasierung hinsichtlich ihres klinischen Verlaufs beobachtet. Schwerpunkt ist die primäre Behandlung bis zum ersten Progress/Rezidiv.
conditions: Malignant neoplasm: Connective and soft tissue of head, face and neck

interventions.name: Patients with soft tissue sarcoma and newly diagnosed distant metastases will be prospectively enrolled in a registry study. Clinical variables will be collected by study physicians with a focus on the primary treatment until the first progression or recurrence. The recruitment period is planned fro

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Histologically confirmed soft tissue sarcoma (according to WHO classification) with first occurrence of distant metastasis
Exclusion criteria:
GIST, Ewing sarcoma, small-, blue-, round-cell sarcoma, rhabdomyosarcoma
